title: A failing sync gate keeps the full output of its failed checks in a file and prints the path and the failed test count
goal: kbgit.py sync and land write each failed check's whole output to _cache/gate/<stamp>-<check>.txt, print its path and the count of FAILED and ERROR test ids, and keep the last few files; today the gate prints only the last 25 lines of a failed check and a retry overwrites what a caller saved, so a second failure scrolled out unseen and one failure's text was lost
notes: Theme: lost evidence. Evidence: kg_sync.py:534-537 prints one tail line per check and the last 25 lines of a failed one; mac-sixth lost a second failure of the ST-72yvwtoz gate and BG-di5pwdrg's failure text to a retry; an unattended stall ladder reads the same tail.
